findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_website_check" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Starts the free frag.hugo website check (Hugo Check) for a public URL: cookies and tracking before consent, consent banner, Google Fonts, privacy policy and imp…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_security, start_website_check, vendor_profile, my_privacy_deadlines · Private data: search_gdpr_fines, check_email_security, start_website_check, my_privacy_deadlines, report_data_breach, create_data_subject_request, plan_software_introduction · Public sink: check_email_security, report_data_breach, create_data_subject_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_security, start_website_check, vendor_profile, my_privacy_deadlines · Private data: search_gdpr_fines, check_email_security, start_website_check, my_privacy_deadlines, report_data_breach, create_data_subject_request, plan_software_introduction · Public sink: check_email_security, report_data_breach, create_data_subject_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
